acceptanceCriteria: Retain hosted evidence of one merge-queue entry ejected for a failing required check on its queue commit: the queue branch, the failing run, the entry leaving the queue, the pull request staying open, and main unchanged.

Retain hosted evidence of one stale or rebuilt group: an entry ahead failing or leaving the queue so a later entry's speculative queue commit is discarded and rebuilt on the new base, with ci-control-plane posted only on the rebuilt commit that merges.
Observe both cases from ordinary queue traffic; deliberately failing a queue entry needs explicit owner authorization first. Unobserved cases stay NOT_OBSERVED, never inferred.
body: Split from CORE-GITHUB-MERGE-QUEUE-COMPATIBILITY-1 at its closeout (2026-10-12), following the owner's split-then-complete choice for V1-0040. The merge queue on main (ruleset 23699808: MERGE, group size 1, max 2 builds, ALLGREEN, 120-minute check timeout) produced its first successful queued merge: PR beamfall/corvint#840 merged at 2026-10-12T19:02:50Z as queue commit 8fb53b265e1e2a46eb7fe8534c16c4bc288a96bc on gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-840-d67ee35d…; CI merge_group run 38292100504 passed go-product and doc-gates; ci-control-plane run 38294958759 (merge-group job) posted ci-control-plane success on that commit; main equals that commit. The parent ticket's criterion 3 also asked for live failed or stale group handling, which ordinary traffic has not produced yet. This ticket owns that evidence. Rollback: none (evidence only); the queue rollback is in docs/build-log/2026-10-12-merge-queue-enabled.md.
title: ci: retain live evidence of failed and stale merge-queue group handling
